The foreground keeps sharp detail, highlighting the dewdrops on flower petals and the fabric textures of their clothing.

The atmosphere is dreamlike yet vivid, a mix of nostalgic romance and urban energy, with saturated colors, soft natural light, and a gentle interplay of textures from flowers, fabric, and reflections.
